disagreements.topic_or_concept: First Law of Thermodynamics and Work Done

source_a.work_definition: W = \int P dV (work done by the system)

source_b.work_definition: w = -\int P_{ext} dV (work done on the system)

disagreements.nature_of_disagreement: Opposite sign conventions for mechanical work between Physics textbooks (work done by system is positive) and Chemistry / IUPAC convention (work done on system is positive).
disagreements.explanation_and_reconciliation: In JEE Physics, the physics convention dQ = dU + dW with dW = P dV is canonical and standard across H.C. Verma, Halliday-Resnick, and University Physics. For an expansion (dV > 0), work done by gas is positive, resulting in a decrease in internal energy under adiabatic conditions (dU = -dW < 0).

disagreements.topic_or_concept: Adiabatic Free Expansion vs Reversible Adiabatic Expansion

source_b.rule: Blindly applying P V^\gamma = const to all adiabatic processes including free expansion

disagreements.nature_of_disagreement: Erroneous assumption that P V^\gamma = const holds for any process with dQ = 0.
disagreements.explanation_and_reconciliation: Free expansion into a vacuum has dQ = 0 and dW = 0, so dU = 0 and temperature remains invariant for an ideal gas (T_f = T_i). However, the process is highly irreversible and turbulent; intermediate states have undefined pressure. Therefore P V^\gamma = const does NOT apply to adiabatic free expansion.

disagreements.topic_or_concept: Cartesian vs Real-Is-Positive Sign Convention in Geometric Optics

source_a.convention: New Cartesian Sign Convention (pole as origin, incident light direction positive)

disagreements.nature_of_disagreement: Different coordinate orientation and sign assignments for object distances, image distances, and radii of curvature.
disagreements.explanation_and_reconciliation: JEE Main and Advanced examinations exclusively utilize the Cartesian coordinate sign convention with 1/v + 1/u = 1/f for mirrors and 1/v - 1/u = 1/f for lenses. All canonical atoms and assessments in this knowledge system enforce the Cartesian convention.

disagreements.topic_or_concept: SI vs Gaussian/CGS Electrodynamic Units and Field Relations

source_a.units: SI (MKS): D = \varepsilon_0 E + P, B = \mu_0 (H + M)

source_b.units: Gaussian / CGS: D = E + 4\pi P, B = H + 4\pi M

disagreements.nature_of_disagreement: Presence of 4\pi factors and fundamental permittivity/permeability constants between SI and Gaussian formulations.
disagreements.explanation_and_reconciliation: Irodov contains problems written originally in the Gaussian system and provides an explicit conversion appendix. For modern JEE Physics, SI units are strictly required. All equations and problem statements mapped into the KB are verified in SI units.
